_metadata.purpose: x02-e single revision round: reviewer-flagged items only

items.reviewerReason: TOOTH via the narwhal's tusk being a tooth and UNICORN via its nickname "unicorn of the sea"; a great fact.
items.reviewerFix: Drop the false cause-and-effect: "A narwhal's spiral 'horn' is really a long tooth, and it earns the narwhal the nickname unicorn of the sea." (The nickname comes from the horn-like look, not from it being a tooth.)

current.wordAConnection: A narwhal's spiral tusk is actually a long tooth.
current.wordBConnection: Narwhals are nicknamed the unicorns of the sea.
current.revealExplanation: A narwhal's "horn" is really a long tooth, which is why it is called the unicorn of the sea.

items.reviewerReason: ELVIS via Graceland in Memphis is instant, but PYRAMID via ancient Egypt's Memphis depends on geography most U.S. players don't know, so the pyramid side is the weak one.
items.reviewerFix: Add the U.S. hook: "Elvis's Graceland is in Memphis, which has its own giant Pyramid arena and is named after the ancient Egyptian capital near the pyramids."

current.wordAConnection: Elvis lived at Graceland in Memphis, Tennessee.
current.wordBConnection: Ancient Memphis, Egypt's old capital, sits beside famous pyramids.
current.revealExplanation: Elvis made his home in Memphis, Tennessee, and Egypt's ancient Memphis lies near famous pyramids.

items.reviewerReason: DOOR via knocking on a door and JOKE via the knock-knock joke; the joke side is a compound, but it is instantly familiar and the joke itself pretends to knock at a door, so it passes as exceptional.
items.reviewerFix: Make it one idea rather than circular: "Every knock-knock joke pretends someone is knocking at your door."

current.revealExplanation: You knock on a door, and every knock-knock joke starts with a knock.
